checkpoint_policy: Restart and validate every 0.5 ps; this is a publication interval, not a total heating cap.
cooling_policy: After reaching the 2300 K peak limit, run source-off cooling for up to 0.5 ps or until all Ag is solid.
note: This is the legacy Ag70 run. It is kept separate from the corrected Ag60.7 wt% model and its results.
stable_pool_rule: tracked for reporting only; it does not end heating before the temperature peak
stop_policy: Heat without a total-time cap until the 2300 K peak limit, switch off the source, then run source-off cooling.
